evidence.detail: rs/l/D is constructed only by R421 RSImageProducer on the first successful BufferedImage draw and is submitted with SwingUtilities.invokeLater.

run() sizes the Launcher JFrame to 1134x537 or 1312x800 depending on the client mode flag, centers it on the screen, ensures visibility where required, and maximizes when the configured layout exceeds the display width.
The Runnable owns no rendering state beyond its synthetic RSImageProducer parent reference and performs only one-shot Launcher JFrame layout/visibility work.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/l/c owns the global int[] pixel buffer, optional float depth buffer, raster width/height and clip bounds, and exposes fill/line/rectangle/alpha drawing operations plus a Graphics2D bridge.
Historical 317 DrawingArea sources expose the same global pixel buffer, width/height, clip rectangle and primitive 2D draw surface; v308 extends that surface with depth/Graphics2D support.
R421 Rasterizer reads rs/l/c pixels, width and clip bounds directly, while R421 TextDrawingArea extends rs/l/c and sprite/UI renderers draw into the same surface.
